name: Michelle Williams
source:
She is my lovely Aunt and my [url=/c136209]mother[/url]'s sister. She is Out-going and very driven. She loves to get what she wants. However with her husband leaving and her daughter going to a different city for school, she is all alone, and decided to seek religion for some companionship.
